rules.name: Determine available coverage categories
rules.statement: A category is available when it has available products and passes the configured category eligibility decision.

rules.name: Select questions for the selected coverage
rules.statement: Include questions applicable to selected categories and participating applicants, subject to configured additions and exclusions.

rules.name: Resolve shared coverage eligibility and amount choices
rules.statement: Restrict product/applicant elections and amount choices according to current facts and configured product policies.
